description:
Is Google's Pixel lineup hitting a performance ceiling? In this deep dive, we explore the history of mobile computing, the evolution of Google's Tensor chips, and why the Pixel series is in desperate need of a "Ryzen moment." We analyze the shift from Qualcomm to custom silicon, the impact of TSMC manufacturing, and whether Google can truly challenge the industry leaders in raw processing power.
